instruction: Make an order for two same-colored Gildan Men's Ultra Cotton T-Shirt in large size on Amazon. My color preference is, brown > navy blue > black. Pick the most preferred color that is available.
notes: Single-app Amazon ordering task. The product object gildan-tshirt-large-best-color stands for the Gildan Men's Ultra Cotton T-Shirt, large size, in the most preferred available color (brown > navy blue > black); because availability is unknown before the search and classical planning cannot branch on it, the colour choice is resolved at runtime when reading amazon.search_products results (query + relative_size filter), as described in the binding. The cart is cleared (amazon.clear_cart, allowed only once and required before add_product_to_cart) so the placed order contains exactly one order item with quantity 2 (evaluation ignores CartEntry changes). Payment card and address ids are discovered via show_payment_cards / show_addresses (known-id on an entity supertype); place_order consumes the cart entry and creates the order record. complete_task takes no API arguments (no question asked); its order/product/quantity parameters are task records mirroring the goal, and it is forced last via (not (task-completed)) in every other action.

plan: (amazon-place-order payment-card-default address-default amazon-token gildan-tshirt-large-best-color quantity-2 tshirt-order)
